name: ledger
description: Read Ledger accounts, balances, history and staking positions, and verify receive addresses with Ledger's wallet-cli 3.

ledger-balance.description: Show Ledger accounts and balances without signing

interface.shortDescription: Inspect a Ledger wallet without signing or sending.
interface.longDescription: Uses Ledger's official wallet-cli (version 3, USB) to discover accounts, read balances, history and staking positions, verify receive addresses on the trusted device display, and check device authenticity. It finds the CLI through AgenC and only installs it after you approve. This plugin never signs, broadcasts, or asks for a recovery phrase.
defaultPrompt: Show my Ledger accounts and balances
Show my staking positions on my Ledger
Verify a receive address on my Ledger
